title: SCADA System Incident Response
description: SCADA system incidents affecting operational control and monitoring
immediate_actions: Assess impact on operational control and grid monitoring
Activate manual operational procedures if needed
investigation_steps: Review SCADA system logs and status
Check network connectivity to SCADA systems
resolution_steps: Restart SCADA services following vendor procedures
Implement network fixes if connectivity issues
Apply SCADA system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with SCADA vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with operational staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Never directly modify operational control systems without customer authorization
Operational technology incidents require NOC escalation
SCADA systems are critical for utility operations
Maintain operational safety during system restoration
